settings.title: Settings
settings.category.display.summary: Resolution, frame rate, HEVC, safe area
settings.category.web.summary: Main and instrument displays in a browser
settings.mfi.ch341_help: Uses the MFi coprocessor on a CH341 USB-to-I2C bridge.
settings.mfi.remote_help: The address starts with http:// or https://. The token is sent as an Authorization bearer token.
settings.mfi.local_help: Select a DER PKCS#7 certificate and its matching unencrypted DER PKCS#8 private key. Both are reloaded when MFi reconnects.
settings.wireless.support: Connect over Bluetooth and Wi-Fi instead of USB
settings.wifi_high_performance.support: Keep Wi-Fi responsive during wireless CarPlay, including in the background. Requests low latency on Android 10+. May increase power use.
hotspot.off_help: Turn on wireless CarPlay to start a hotspot.
settings.vehicle.report_location.support: Sends precise Android location as CarPlay GPS data when the iPhone asks for it
settings.vehicle.precise_positioning.sup: Also sends the real fix quality, satellites used and sea-level altitude; any value Android cannot provide is left as before
settings.vehicle.applies_on_close: Use Restart CarPlay at the top right to save reporting changes; closing settings discards them.
settings.audio.buffer.support: Larger values absorb network jitter but add delay
settings.audio.channel_mapping.support: Routes Android Automotive audio buses by CarPlay audio type
settings.audio.focus.support: Request system audio focus while the host is open so other apps pause; turn off to mix with other audio
settings.audio.quality.summary: Voice quality, sample rate and channels
settings.audio.quality.help: These are the maximum parameters exposed to CarPlay, not the negotiated result — the iPhone chooses the actual format. Values reflect what this device can play/decode; the system may resample. Changes apply after saving and reconnecting.
settings.audio.quality.opus.support: Recommended. Better voice quality over wireless CarPlay. Turning it off switches to a compatibility codec, available only when this device supports it.
settings.audio.quality.compatibility_una: This device cannot use Opus's fallback codec, so wireless CarPlay would have no sound with Opus off.
settings.audio.quality.check_failed: Could not check this device's audio support, so the options cannot be shown.
settings.audio.quality.unsupported: No usable combination on this device. Pick different settings.
settings.display.scale.support: Changes the pixels reported to iPhone, not a cropped zoom. Icon/text layout also depends on the physical reference below.
settings.display.hevc.support: Smaller video stream; turn off to use H.264
settings.display.hevc_software.support: Use when the hardware decoder shows artefacts
Lets CarPlay wallpaper fill the area outside it
safe_area.unavailable: Available once the display has a size
safe_area.editor.title: Safe area
safe_area.editor.help: Drag the four edges to the usable part of the screen
settings.web.enabled.support: Any browser on the same network can show this display
settings.web.preview.support: Fit a preview of the configured resolution on this screen
settings.web.no_network: Connect to a local network to get an address
settings.web.https_note: Web displays use HTTPS with a self-signed certificate so browsers can decode with WebCodecs (H.265 included). Each browser warns once; choose to continue.
settings.web.apply_note: Changes apply after Save and reconnect.
settings.window.auto_start.support: Opens CarPlay automatically after the device starts
settings.window.hide_top.support: Swipe from the top edge to show it briefly
settings.window.hide_bottom.support: Swipe from the bottom edge to show it briefly
settings.window.edge_gesture.support: One finger down the top-left edge to the bottom
settings.window.three_finger_help: A three-finger swipe down always opens settings.
settings.diagnostics.latency.support: Shows live video latency, frame rate and audio latency
settings.diagnostics.debug_logs.support: Adds a Debug tab to the home log and shows it over video
settings.diagnostics.audio_capture.suppo: Saves encrypted UDP and decrypted RTP audio packets
settings.diagnostics.raw_video.support: Adds the original video packets to the log file
settings.diagnostics.bluetooth.support: Pair or forget phones in system settings
settings.compat.title: Android 9 compatibility
settings.compat.p2p: Wi-Fi P2P (5 GHz) is unavailable; LocalOnlyHotspot is used instead.
settings.compat.hevc: The software HEVC decoder is unavailable; hardware decoding is used instead.
crop.help: Drag to move, pinch to zoom
crop.not_ready: The image is not ready yet
settings.audio.music_output.support: Media by default; choose the Android output usage for music
settings.audio.navigation_output.support: Navigation by default; try Media if guidance is silent
settings.audio.navigation_volume.support: 0% mute, 100% original, up to 200%; leaves system volume unchanged; boosting may distort
settings.audio.routing.help: Tap Restart CarPlay to save and apply. Volume affects identified navigation/alert audio even when bound to Media, leaving music, calls and Siri unchanged. Firmware controls physical routing. Guidance already mixed into music by the phone cannot be adjusted separately.
settings.apply_help: Changes are saved when you restart CarPlay. Back closes settings without saving.
settings.wifi_recovery.support: For automatic hotspots only: release the failed hotspot, try switching Wi-Fi off and on, then retry once. Some Android versions block Wi-Fi switching.
settings.vehicle.diagnostics_help: Run live diagnostics to check ADB, protocol and readings.
settings.mfi.no_picker: No document picker on this device: {reason}
settings.validation.server_scheme: Remote server address must start with http:// or https://
settings.validation.private_key_invalid: Local private key URI contains U+0000
settings.validation.ssid_length: Hotspot SSID must be at most 32 UTF-8 bytes
settings.validation.channel_band: Channel is not valid for the selected band
settings.validation.password_open: Password must be empty when security is Open
settings.vehicle.feature.altitude.title: GPS altitude
settings.vehicle.feature.gps_speed.title: GPS speed
settings.vehicle.feature.gps_speed.descr: Ground speed in RMC; independent of wheel speed
settings.vehicle.feature.course.title: GPS course
settings.vehicle.feature.course.descript: Direction of travel in RMC, when available
settings.vehicle.feature.accuracy.title: GPS accuracy
settings.vehicle.feature.accuracy.descri: Approximate HDOP from Android horizontal accuracy
settings.vehicle.feature.precise_positio: GGA fix quality, satellites and sea-level altitude when available
settings.vehicle.feature.wheel_speed.des: Read speed and gear over approved ADB for iPhone dead reckoning. Off by default; save and restart CarPlay to apply.
settings.vehicle.feature.ev_status.title: Battery and range reporting
settings.vehicle.feature.ev_status.descr: Provide available percentage, range, remaining energy and charging state. Off by default; navigation app use is not guaranteed.
settings.scan_pause: Pause automatic network search while connected
settings.scan_pause.support: Wi-Fi Direct only. Requires approved local ADB; applies after saving and restarting CarPlay.
settings.scan_pause.help: Adapted from DiPlay: pauses framework Wi-Fi autojoin to reduce off-channel searches on single-radio head units. It may also prevent the car from automatically joining a phone hotspot. Other apps can still scan. Restores on disconnect or next launch after an abnormal exit. Park first, enable legacy network ADB on local port 5555, then authorize below. Pairing-code-only wireless debugging is unsupported.
settings.scan_pause.ready: Local ADB approved. Save and restart CarPlay to try scan protection. Firmware support varies; check the connection log.
settings.scan_pause.not_approved: Not approved. Allow this app in the car’s debugging prompt, then retry.
settings.scan_pause.pairing_only: This ADB requires TLS pairing, which is unsupported. Legacy network ADB is required.
settings.scan_pause.unavailable: Local ADB unavailable or check failed. Enable network ADB on port 5555 in the car’s system settings.
settings.channel.fallback: Fall back to automatic on rejection
settings.channel.fallback.support: Retries once with automatic 5 GHz only after explicit platform rejection. No channel fallback on timeout, denied permission or cancellation.
settings.channel.help: Applies after saving and restarting CarPlay. Preferences request channel 36 or 149 first; fixed mode offers common non-DFS channels. Firmware, regional rules or Wi-Fi concurrency may reject or override requests. The observed channel is authoritative. No ADB required; no intentional channel changes during a connection.
settings.channel.other_mode: Channel requests require Wi-Fi Direct on Android 10+. The system selects automatic-hotspot channels. For a manual hotspot, change the channel in the car’s system settings; entering a channel here does not retune it.
settings.channel.observed: Last observed hotspot channel: {channel} ({band}). May change on the next connection.
settings.channel.unknown: Last observed hotspot channel: not yet available. Shown after a successful connection.
settings.vehicle.byd_help: Read-only speed, gear, battery, range, remaining energy and charging state. Enable network ADB, authorize, and run live diagnostics first. Enable reporting below and use Restart CarPlay to save. No vehicle controls.
settings.vehicle.byd_diagnostics_help: Diagnostics stop after 10 minutes or when settings close and never report to iPhone. Tyre pressure/temperature are diagnostic only; no CarPlay mapping. Unsupported readings stay unavailable.
settings.vehicle.adb_ready: Local ADB authorized. Run live diagnostics, then enable the reporting you need and save.
settings.display.fast_areas.support: Off by default: negotiate only the current window so old split-window/safe-area sizes cannot affect startup. On reuses saved areas to reduce some reconnects. Save and restart CarPlay to apply.
settings.display.compatibility.support: Startup waits for stable window/system-bar dimensions. Layout transitions preserve aspect ratio and touches in letterbox bars are ignored.
settings.display.restore_defaults.suppor: Restore 1.0x resolution, 60 FPS, 200 mm long-edge reference and single-area compatibility. Reset the safe area separately below. Restart CarPlay saves; closing settings discards.
settings.audio.stream.support: 0 keeps the usage binding above; 1–20 select a head-unit stream. Save and restart CarPlay to apply. Unsupported streams fall back to usage routing.
settings.call_popup.title: Hide BYD call popup (experimental)
settings.call_popup.support: Off by default. Requires Android 10+, the BYD Bluetooth-call component and approved local ADB.
settings.call_popup.help: Save and restart CarPlay to apply. Temporarily suppresses the native call overlay only while connected CarPlay is foreground, restoring it on background, disconnect or exit. A detached helper also attempts recovery after losing its heartbeat. Bluetooth audio and the full-screen phone app are unchanged.
settings.call_popup.adb_ready: Local ADB approved. Save and restart CarPlay to apply the call-popup switch. Actual support depends on head-unit firmware.
